identification: Passap Duomatic 80 double-bed domestic knitting machine (Swiss made, serial on front bed .3005368) on original folding metal stand, with green Duomatic 80 lock (row counter reading 0163), Passap 'color' 4-colour changer and Passap 'electra' motor drive (Electra unit with ◄ ► COL lights and OK / COL / CO-STOP buttons, model number not visible; the Electra used on the Duomatic 80 is usually the Electra 2000 or 4000), dealer sticker 'Passap Tasmania, 6 Merino Place, Bridgewater TAS 7030'. Extras in three tubs and a box: Passap U-70 transfer carriage; a second, older grey Passap lock with red dials and AX/BX/CX/EX/FX/GX pattern chart (older Duomatic lock); yarn winder (blue/white, Royal style) and cone holder; weights, cast-on comb, claw weights, wire springs; grey needle pusher strips/needle bed parts; a maroon motor box (possibly the Electra drive belt/motor unit or a swift); binders, pattern cards and a 'Fashion' paper. Untested, completeness unknown.

viewing_check: Power up the Electra and check the carriage moves both ways and the colour changer cycles; check the dealer label and look for the Electra model plate underneath. Confirm the back bed and both locks (green Duomatic 80 and the older grey one) are present; look for bent/missing needles and rust on the beds; check the U-70 transfer carriage, pushers and the Deco unit if any. Count the manuals.
